title: Sidh Sain of Mandi Sends a Vakil

blocks.text: Episode 50 opens with the Mandi ruler Sidh Sain hearing of Banda’s rise and deciding to approach him through a vakil rather than immediate conflict.
The ruler presents himself as linked to the Guru’s house, receives a reassuring reply, and begins the Mandi sequence under a sign of caution mixed with respect.
Sidh Sain is the essential anchor here, because the page is less about battle than about political approach and measured recognition.
